title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00106 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling

00:45 - 01:00: Performed pre-job meeting before p/u flat bottom milling BHA
01:00 - 02:00: P/u and m/u flat bottom milling BHA
02:00 - 02:30: RIH w/ flat bottom milling BHA to 135m, p/u and m/u space out pup
